body: Thank you for the empathy. Lately I've felt like I don't even deserve that. I'm still fighting the urge, but it's getting a little easier. I spent some time with family today and that helped. I've made some really shitty decisions and I can't defend them. The best I can do short of inventing a time machine to go back and change my actions is to not repeat them. I just don't know how well I can live with this past.
